SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops
